name: Agnes Versebound
acting: Half-lidded downward gaze and a little disapproving frown.
personality: Protects a ritual from anyone inclined to enjoy it prematurely.
bio: Agnes blesses HyperNorm incident reports before the ink dries. She keeps a separate book for incidents that refuse to settle.
note: Her book contained three corrections and a remarkably pointed amen.
call: That was in the previous verse.

name: Bruno Splitlog
acting: Head tilted back, eyes up and a loud triumphant laugh.
personality: Finds almost any impasse easier to split than discuss.
bio: Bruno was employed to cut through red tape. The first office thanked him. The second asked for its door back.
note: He has been asked to handle matters more delicately. He sharpened the smaller edge.

name: Felix Softnote
acting: Closed eyes and puckered singing mouth.
personality: Hits a soft note just when the room wants a speech.
bio: Felix plays the anthem at HyperNorm ceremonies. The verse that gets the loudest applause is the one he was told to leave out.
note: I heard the tune perfectly. It took me a week to realize he had changed the words.
call: Quiet now. Here's the loud part.
voice: Light tenor that can drop to a whisper.

name: Ada Fizzwell
acting: Wide uneven eyes toward the flask and a wavy tight mouth.
personality: Knows exactly how much confidence to add before it froths.
bio: Ada was asked to distill reassurance for HyperNorm. Her best sample turned green whenever anyone was reassuring.
note: The flask bubbled as we thanked her for her time.

name: Moss Knucklebell
acting: Sidelong glance toward the hand and a crooked smirk.
personality: Delegates small errands with unnerving patience.
bio: Moss brings back witnesses who were filed as unavailable. The hand is the only one that still remembers the meeting schedule.
note: It rang twice. I had asked a yes-or-no question and received both.
call: All in favor, raise a hand.

name: Cal Clackwork
acting: Eyes fixed on the claw and clenched square teeth.
personality: Has an adjustment for everything, especially the adjustments.
bio: Cal builds a claw to retrieve cards from narrow HyperNorm files. The prototype keeps selecting the wrong card with remarkable confidence.
note: It pinched the corner of my report. The clerk called this a successful grip test.
